title: DeFiTorch
tagline: Multichain Crypto & Stablecoins Portfolio Tracking with investment suggestions
description: If you are not a day trader, tools to keep track of your portfolio are very limited. CoinMarketCap is very manual, and Zapper doesn’t give you information about your performance - just a snapshot of your current status. We are automatically fetching all your transactions & assign dollar value that was true at the time of crypto purchase or sale. We automatically calculate if your portfolio is currently profitable or not.
how_its_made: We are using etherscan APIs to fetch transactions and Uniswap APIs to get values for those transactions at the given date. We are also using Wallet Connect APIs + AAVE and Cream protocol APIs to fetch investment opportunities for the given wallet. We are also using The Graph for price queries, pool APY queries and user position queries on lending protocols.
